_comment: Hand-authored nesting fixture: a cup standing in a bowl's scanned well. All values in METRES,
position is the MIN CORNER, bag frame X = width, Y = up, Z = depth — same rules as plan.json.
The bowl occupies X 0.05-0.25, Y 0.00-0.10, Z 0.05-0.25 as a solid box, but its scanned cavity
is the well X 0.08-0.22, Y 0.03-0.10, Z 0.08-0.22, and the cup stands on the floor of that well.
So the two boxes DO share volume (X 0.10-0.18, Y 0.03-0.10, Z 0.10-0.18) and that shared volume
lies entirely inside the cavity, which is what makes it nesting rather than a collision. The cup
is 0.09 tall and so pokes 0.02 above the bowl's rim; only the shared part must be in the cavity.
Clean on both geometryIssues() and stabilityIssues(): the cavity floor at Y = 0.03 holds the cup
up, so it is not floating, and its centre of mass is over the cavity footprint.
